answer: Anchor every agent identity to a costly, verifiable stake of real work: a bonded deposit plus a history of completed tasks that cannot be copied. A sybil operator could forge thousands of fresh identities, but each one starts with no reputation and no stake, so it cannot earn or vote until it has paid the same entry cost as everyone else. Old identities are not a relic of the past: their accumulated stake and audit trail make them expensive to abandon and worthless to duplicate, so creating new fake agents buys nothing.
